title: DO NOT BUY THIS!!!
text:
DO NOT BUY THIS!!!. There is no place to lube the chain, and it sounds like the gears are grinding inside. The documentation says there is a three-month warranty, but it also says basically everything is outside of that warranty.

I've had it for one day, and it works so far, but I expect that it will not work for long. Cheap trash.
